content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need to compare two counter values in a [product_name] [article_no] module. If both values are equal, I need the output to indicate this. How can I achieve that?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Unfortunately, what you're asking can't be done with a [product_name] [article_no].

If you only require a forward counter with low values, you can create custom counters using pulse relays. This allows for value comparison, but you're limited to just 56 program blocks and minimal retentivity. Please see the attached example for reference. Regards, [user_name]

Hi, While this might not work with [article_no] due to version differences, the attached files might be helpful. They compare two counters (activated by I1 and I2) and trigger Q1 if equal. Hope this assists you. Edit: Noticed that the necessary mathematical instruction isn't available on the [article_no] version—sorry for the oversight.

It's best to first select your module type in [product_name] software before writing the program. You can't get a counter value directly in [article_no]—only a comparison with a single parameter inside a counter block is possible. Regards, [user_name]
